emerging_technology: NPU-accelerated on-device AI inference on edge-computing laptops
intended_application: Evaluate local transcription and summarization of internal meetings on managed laptops in connected offices; employees review and edit all summaries.
business_need: Reduce time spent drafting internal meeting notes while controlling access to confidential material.
users_stakeholders: Consultants, meeting participants, IT, privacy and information-security teams, procurement
capabilities_constraints: Assume reliable office connectivity, a managed laptop fleet and an existing approved cloud collaboration service. Device compatibility, actual model quality, data retention and the incremental cost of new laptops are unknown.
risk_consequence_context: Summaries could omit commitments or reveal confidential client information; employees remain accountable for records and access control.
management_question: For the 2027 laptop refresh, does on-device transcription and summarization offer enough benefit over the existing cloud workflow to justify a limited pilot?
time_horizon: 2027 refresh planning; evaluate a limited pilot before a procurement commitment
additional_context: Hypothetical 2027 planning case prepared from the primary intake; all organization details and monitoring triggers are assumptions, not verified observations or forecasts. Technology is held constant across cases. Source seed: Microsoft, Copilot+ PCs developer guide, accessed 2026-11-16, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/ai/npu-devices. This vendor documentation describes supported NPU development; it does not independently establish performance, privacy or value for this organization. Seek multiple independent dated sources and verify current products, costs and claims at decision time; do not invent 2027 outcomes. Baseline: existing laptops with approved cloud transcription and human note-taking. Complements: compatible meeting software, device management, encrypted storage, model updates and access controls. Compared with the primary case, connectivity is assumed reliable, so offline availability is less important; compare quality, privacy controls, compatibility, support burden and total cost. IT and privacy leads review quarterly; reconsider if independently tested results meet pre-agreed quality and security thresholds at an acceptable incremental cost, or if material policy, vendor support or pricing changes. Hype-sensitive claim: all on-device AI is automatically private and cheaper. Local execution, data handling and cloud fallback must be verified for the actual application.
